verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents automatic booking-category suggestions, which is the core of the story. The claim sits beside receipt capture rather than imported bank transactions, though, and nothing shows the suggestions learn from user corrections. Missing for 10: evidence that suggestions apply to imported bank transactions, any learning from user corrections, depth documentation of the suggestion engine, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: Receive a suggestion for the right booking category automatically.
Seamlessly merge your business account and bookkeeping and pay your invoices directly from sevdesk.
